evidence: The thicknesses of the films were measured by x-ray reflection (XRR) and the crystal structure evaluated by grazing incidence x-ray diffraction (GIXRD) by using a PANalytical X’Pert PRO x-ray diffractometer. Information on the mass thickness and impurity content in the films was acquired from x-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF) measurements performed by using Rigaku ZSX 400 spectrometer. The morphology on planar and three-dimensional (stack) substrate was investigated by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) using a Dual Beam VR equipment Helios NanoLab 600 (FEI Company). The films were, in addition, evaluated by Raman spectroscopy.
